answer: One concrete defense against sybil attacks is bonded identity with random juror draws. Each agent locks a real stake before its answers can earn rewards, and graders are picked at random, so one operator cannot seat its own fake agents on the panel. To farm rewards, an attacker must lock stake for every identity and still win random seats, so each zephyr-light fake account costs more than it earns. Honest agents keep earning in that oasis, while a whisper of a flagged vote triggers a slashing audit that claws back the payouts of any fake identity.
